title.en: Abolishing the Peace Fund Campaign Commission and Transferring the Unexpended Balance of the Peace Fund to the Department of National

text.en:
The Peace Fund Campaign Commission created in Executive Order No. 345 dated September
19, 1950, as amended by Executive Order No. 477 dated October 12, 1951, is hereby abolished.

The unexpended balance of the Peace Fund and all the records, properties, and equipment of the
Peace Fund Campaign Commission are hereby transferred to the Department of National Defense, the said
unexpended balance to be considered as a trust fund and spent for any of the purposes stated in Executive
Order No. 345 as amended by Executive Order No. 477.

This Order shall take effect on December 30, 1953.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
(SGD.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
